description: This file contains unit tests for the PolicyTrie class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.enforcers.trie package. It tests various functionalities such as object creation from policies, traversal, seeking nodes, and building JSON views, specifically targeting the PolicyTrie implementation in the context of Eclipse Ditto policy enforcement.

classes.name: PolicyTrieTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the PolicyTrie class, covering creation, traversal, seeking, and JSON view building functionalities.

methods.description: Initializes static test constants before all tests.
